title: PhaseStart
description: Server to all, event `phase:start`. Identical for every player, so a phone screen gives nothing away. Clients compare serverNow to their own clock and shift endsAt by the difference, so countdowns stay within 1 second.

endsAt.description: When the phase ends, in server time.

serverNow.description: Server time when the event was sent. Clients use it to correct their own clock.
